title: Count Digit Appearances
goal: Solve Count Digit Appearances: Extract decimal digits with remainder and division, tracking per-number contributions and the total.
strategy: Extract decimal digits with remainder and division, tracking per-number contributions and the total.

phasePurposes.number: Load a number and reset its local contribution.
phasePurposes.extract: Inspect the rightmost digit, count a match, then remove it.
phasePurposes.finish: The quotient is zero, so no digits remain.
phasePurposes.done: Return all occurrences, not merely the number of matching elements.

edgeCases: Repeated occurrences inside one number all count; a zero digit is counted when it appears inside a positive input number.
inputRules: Enter {"nums":[12,22],"digit":2}: 1–1000 positive integers up to 1,000,000, and a digit from 0 to 9.
